title: [LOGGED OUT] Form fields in the popups have names for screen readers
reason: Log in fields are not linked to their labels (label for=log-name/log-pass, inputs have id loginusername/loginpassword); Contact Email input (id recipient-email) has no label (its label points to recipient-name). Step 4 has no own screenshot.

steps.text: Open https://www.demoblaze.com/ in the browser and wait until the page has finished loading.
Read the label of the "Username:" and "Password:" fields (label "for" or aria-label).
steps.saw: label for="log-name" (Username:), label for="log-pass" (Password:); inputs have id=loginusername and id=loginpassword, no aria-label, no aria-labelledby, not wrapped in a label.

steps.text: Are both Log in fields linked to their labels?
steps.saw: Neither field is linked: label for values (log-name, log-pass) do not match the input ids (loginusername, loginpassword).

steps.text: Click "Close". Then click "Contact" in the header.
steps.saw: Log in popup closed, Contact popup 'New message' opened.

steps.text: Is the "Contact Email:" field linked to its label?
steps.saw: Input id=recipient-email has no label: both the Contact Email: and Contact Name: labels use for=recipient-name, so the email input is not linked and the name input gets two labels.
